claims.quote: A form that waits reads a logic variable's value once the variable is bound, also where it runs into a form that waits again: in `["rule", ["out", "?x", ["cond", [["number/equals?", "?x", 0], "?x"], ["else", ["find", ["number/add", "?k", ["cond", [["even", "?x"], "?x"], ["else", "?x"]]], ["link", "?x", "?k"]]]]], ["n", "?x"]]`, the `cond` that asks `["even", "?x"]` inside the `find`'s template asks it of the value `?x` has, and the rule gives what plain code gives with `?x` bound. It failed with `Expected number`, because that `cond` took `?x` for a new variable.
